item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu-script body in [porta-shah-baba.md](src/data/lyrics/porta-shah-baba.md) and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified line alignment across the preamble and all ten stanzas, set the direction to right-to-left, and removed `noUrdu`.

The Roman readings “Khoordo sina” and “asfa” are ambiguous. I rendered them as “خوردہ سناں” and “اصفا”.
